en.headline: Election Committee turnout reaches 69.61 per cent by 11am
en.dek: A total of 3,974 voters have cast ballots out of 5,709 eligible electors as of 11am on Sunday, according to official figures.
body: The Electoral Affairs Commission reported that the cumulative turnout for the Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections stood at 69.61 per cent by 11am on Sunday, with 3,974 votes recorded from an electorate of 5,709.

Polling stations opened at 9am across five ordinary locations and two dedicated stations. Early figures showed strong participation in several subsectors, including the commercial third subsector which recorded full turnout by 11am, and the agriculture and fisheries subsector at 88.74 per cent.

The elections cover 31 subsectors with 856 candidates contesting 723 seats. The new Election Committee will play a role in the next chief executive election and in the 2029 Legislative Council election. Officials have urged eligible voters to cast their ballots before polls close at 6pm.
Turnout figures are issued periodically for reference and may be updated as counting proceeds. The Electoral Affairs Commission said arrangements at polling stations were proceeding smoothly.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉截至上午11時投票率69.61%
zh.dek: 選舉事務處公布，截至周日上午11時，5709名合資格投票人中已有3974人投票，累積投票率達69.61%。
body: 選舉事務處表示，二〇二六年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉截至周日上午11時的累積投票率為69.61%，共有3974人投票，合資格投票人數為5709人。
投票站於上午9時開放，全港設有五個一般投票站及兩個專用投票站。多個界別分組投票率偏高，商界（第三）截至11時已達100%，漁農界則錄得88.74%。
是次選舉涵蓋31個界別分組，856名候選人競逐723個席位。新一屆選舉委員會將參與下屆行政長官選舉，並在2029年立法會選舉中提名及選出部分議員。當局呼籲合資格投票人於下午6時結束前前往投票。
投票數字屬臨時參考性質，當局將持續更新。選舉事務處指各票站運作暢順。
